text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"four-paragraph structure with intro, reasons, counterpoint, conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged into clear parts that guide the reader through the argument in a more deliberate way."},{"evidence":"states positives and negatives, then returns to a clear pro-driverless-cars claim","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay develops a position with reasons and then reinforces that position at the end."},{"evidence":"mentions fuel efficiency, lower emissions, public transportation savings, liability, and traffic law","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"The essay uses multiple relevant details from the article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"asks who is to blame, what if there's an accident","quality":"issue framing","description":"The essay presents the debate as a real policy problem by focusing on the key consequences of the technology."},{"evidence":"acknowledges the risk and law concerns before rebutting them","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay shows stronger argumentative maturity by recognizing objections and responding to them."},{"evidence":"clear topic sentences like 'Traffic law is the biggest hurdle'","quality":"focus","description":"The essay keeps each paragraph centered on one main point instead of drifting among unrelated ideas."}]}
